description: DEMONSTRATION DATA ONLY. Annotations are author-created for evaluation demonstration.
text: Machine Learning is a branch of artificial intelligence that enables computers to learn from data. Natural Language Processing refers to the ability of computers to understand human language. Deep learning means a subset of machine learning using neural networks. Google and Microsoft are leading organizations in AI research.
